title: Sergei S
content: In 2021, I lost someone very close to me and felt a constant sense of guilt, grief, regret, and endless sadness that I could not save them or that I did not do everything possible within my power. My experience happened on an ordinary day when nothing hinted at anything unusual. It was one of the last sunny days of October, when the weather was still warm enough to enjoy the sunlight. I sat in a chair on the balcony with headphones, basking in the sun. At some point, a bright point of light appeared in front of me. The light was not close, but as if existing beyond distance. It was as though it was both two meters and two kilometers away at the same time. I became sharply aware of its lack of dimension, scale, or definable distance. Then the light grew in size, expanding to human-like proportions. The first thing I felt was kindness that was gentle, welcoming, and serene. I felt a sense of peace and warmth radiated from it; reassuring me not to worry. This understanding came to me wordlessly, as natural as a friend entering the room and asking, "How are you?" A moment later, I saw a being that defied human definition. No words could accurately capture its essence. A telepathic message reached me, "Hello, I'm so glad to see you again" in a simple and calm way. I watched without surprise, as if this were the most ordinary thing. As he drew near, tears streamed from my eyes. The sight of him was indescribably perfect, beyond flaws. It was glowing bright with a golden, laser-like precision of form. Though I thought of him as male, he was truly a being of light, without gender. His face was radiant yet indistinct. He wore what might have been a robe or cloak made of light that shimmeringly extended over part of him. His height surpassed human measure; likely over three meters if scaled proportionally. Behind him pulsed an immense, living source of light that radiated in all directions. That light seemed fundamental, like the essence of life itself. It was so profoundly beautiful, loving, and perfect that no earthly words could capture its majesty. To imagine or invent such splendor is impossible; this a encounter with the divine was beyond human comprehension. Words fail me because anything I could say diminishes the purity of what I encountered. This sacred, untouchable presence would have brought me to my knees had I been standing. Its power was incomprehensible; its essence surpassing kindness, love, intelligence in all we know. It was knowing that was all-accepting, purer than anything conceivable. It understood me better than I ever could. No words were needed; knowledge was woven into the experience itself. I turned away, not from brightness, but from the ache of my own imperfection in the face of such holiness. I wept, yet I felt forgiven, wholly embraced despite my flaws. His love was so overwhelming that he seemed to temper it, lest it destroy me. Had it lasted longer, I might have collapsed under its intensity. Then, something shifted. My surroundings faded or I crossed some threshold. "I" became him, and "he" became me. It was a merging beyond description. I felt utter ecstasy, boundless joy, love so consuming it felt sacred. It was dissolving and all-encompassing. I also felt infinite warmth, purity, and openness. I longed to stay forever. Rapidly, images flashed before me. I could barely grasp them. There were scenes of suffering: the impoverished, the oppressed, creatures and people society rejects. With impossible tenderness, he bound us together. "You, me, them; we are one whole." I felt his love that I should feel for them. A love so crushing and full of compassion, that I wept with the sheer force of it. The unity was profound; an existence higher than the sum of its parts. This was beauty. More images sped through my mind, fading too quickly to grasp. Then, the images were over. For weeks afterwards, I glowed and brimmed with quiet joy. Every day, I remember and remain grateful for this gift. We are all one. Separation is illusion. I would urge everyone to love, forgive, and embrace all as deeply as you can. Love and kindness are the truest things we have. Our nature is love, caged by human frailty; but the bars are not unbreakable. This experience freed me from grief, from guilt. I feel forgiven. Thank you for reading. May peace be with you.

elements.At the time of your experience, was ther: No, Occurred in the usual atmosphere of the house, Other (briefly specify), The state of peace
elements.Did you feel separated from your body?: I lost awareness of my body
elements.How did your highest level of consciousn: More consciousness and alertness than normal, It goes beyond human consciousness. The most elevated states of consciousness that can hardly be described in words
elements.At what time during the experience were: During merging with the being and uniting with other people
elements.Please compare your vision during the ex: It was like sitting on a quiet summer day on a green lawn and suddenly a locomotive with a freight train rushes by. The energy was overwhelming. I would have died if not for feeling his love. It was indescribably powerful, mighty yet kind and tender. It is hard to understand how these concepts combine. Strength and power are usually separate from kindness, but here they coexisted.
elements.Please compare your hearing during the e: I had headphones on with music playing, but I don’t remember sound during the experience. There were sensations, feelings, understanding, and knowledge instead.
elements.Did you see, or feel surrounded by, a br: A light clearly of mystical or other-worldly origin
elements.Did you see an unearthly light?: Yes, This entity obscured the light, but it seemed intelligent and attentive. I cannot describe it exactly because it was beyond my understanding. If asked in one word, I would say 'sacred,' though even that falls short.
elements.Did you seem to enter some other, uneart: A clearly mystical or unearthly realm, It wasn’t peace but a union with the being that consisted of intense experiences as if we merged into one. Words like 'magnificent' and 'stunning' only faintly describe it.
elements.What emotions did you feel during the ex: I felt the enormous power of love and complete acceptance. There was no concept of evil. No one had ever accepted me the way he did.
elements.Did you feel a sense of harmony or unity: I felt no longer in conflict with nature
elements.Did scenes from the future come to you?: Scenes from my personal future, A series of pictures flashed quickly through my mind, sped up compared to when he connected me with others. I’m unsure if they were past or future because I didn’t retain a single image.
elements.Have your religious practices changed si: Yes, He was very kind, so kind that I don't know how I feel about religion now. I think he would have told me it's okay to believe in what I want, and that I was loved very much.
elements.Did your experience include features con: Content that was entirely not consistent with the beliefs you had at the time of your experience, Perhaps I didn't quite understand the question. Before this, I didn't live in the categories of the spiritual world or God, but I can't say that I'm an atheist.
elements.Did you have a change in your values and: Yes, To say that I was surprised after this experience is an understatement. My entire understanding of the universe was turned upside down. I began to absorb information about near-death experiences, read books, reviews, and watch films. All of this ceased to interest me; material things, the world of people, possessions, achievements, careers, and money. It is unnecessary dust and vanity.
elements.During your experience, did you gain inf: Yes, Unity was the main message. Beyond experiences, he emphasized oneness, love, and kindness as the core of everything.

Yes, Yes. Kindness, love, and compassion for each other, especially for animals and people rejected by society. They emphasized that these were minorities unloved by most people, as well as snakes and worms, who are feared and disliked but are part of the world.
Yes, Yes, there is life beyond this one, and it feels more alive than earthly existence.
Yes, Love, compassion, and kindness to each other. That's the most important thing. I think that experience imprinted those concepts in me for the rest of my life.
elements.What life changes occurred in your life: I can't say that I became a different person. I am grateful that I was given such an experience. I was there, and it was so wonderful.
elements.Was the experience difficult to express: Yes, There were states and experiences that I do not understand and cannot explain. It was like another dimension of being that was not earthly existence, but its opposite.
elements.How accurately do you remember the exper: I remember the experience more accurately than other life events that occurred around the time of the experience
elements.Do you have any psychic, non-ordinary or: Yes, Poetry started pouring out of me. I began thinking in verse, describing what I saw around me. Several times, I woke up realizing I had been thinking in verse in my sleep.
elements.Are there one or several parts of your e: The union with the being of light and the unity with others was indescribably beautiful.
elements.Did you have any knowledge of near death: Yes, I think I watched a few videos on YouTube at one time and saw the movie Ghost. Maybe I read something, but I wasn't interested in details.
elements.What did you believe about the reality o: Experience was definitely real, It was so real that I began to doubt my life on earth. We are here as if in a dream, in a veil, or behind a screen.
